children: Shares of Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) extended their rally on Thursday, November 19, rising as much as 7.25% to an intraday high of ₹128.49.
The latest gains have taken the stock up nearly 8% over five sessions and extended its winning streak to three trading sessions, during which it has advanced around 10.25%.
IREDA is also up around 28% so far in November and is on course for its strongest monthly performance since July 2024.

The November rally has also broken a six-month losing streak. The stock had declined in nine of the 11 months so far in 2026, leaving it down around 8% year-to-date despite the recent recovery. It is down more than 12% over the past year.

IREDA shares now stand around 30% above their 52-week low of ₹98.78, recorded on October 26 this year. However, they remain about 15% below their 52-week high of ₹151, hit on November 18, 2025. The stock is still down nearly 60% from its all-time high of ₹310, that the stock had surged to in 2024.
The stock is trading above its key moving averages, including the 50-day, 100-day and 200-day averages, indicating a recovery in its price trend.

However, its Relative Strength Index (RSI) is hovering around 75. An RSI reading above 70 is generally considered to indicate an overbought zone, suggesting the stock has seen a sharp run-up and could be susceptible to near-term profit-taking.
IREDA reported largely steady profitability for the September quarter, alongside an improvement in asset quality and operating profit.
Net profit edged up 0.5% year-on-year to ₹552 crore from ₹549 crore. Operating profit increased 16.5% to ₹904 crore from ₹776 crore.
Asset quality also improved sequentially. Gross non-performing assets (NPAs) declined 19 basis points to 3.57% from 3.76% in the June quarter, while net NPAs fell 15 basis points to 1.08% from 1.23%.
IREDA has over 24 lakh public shareholders

IREDA also has a sizeable retail investor base. Its shareholding pattern at the end of the September quarter, shows 24.01 lakh public shareholders, collectively holding 28.24% of the company's equity.
Resident individuals holding shares with a nominal value of up to ₹2 lakh account for 23.70 lakh of these shareholders and hold 20.39% of the company's total equity.
The stock was trading at ₹128.03, up 6.9%, around the time of reporting.

title: IREDA shares rally 7%, head for best month since July 2024 after six-month losing streak
